subject: 121 Second Street Two-Family Residence
overview: The board approved several variances for a residential construction project after the applicant presented revised plans that reduced the building's massing and height. The session concluded with updates on board appointments and the upcoming meeting schedule.

items.title: 121 Second Street
items.summary: Approved variances for lot area, width, depth, setbacks, and coverage to replace a single-family home with a two-family building. The board found the revised design's reduction in massing and height addressed prior concerns regarding neighborhood consistency and abutter impact.

items.title: Administrative Updates
items.summary: Noted that no applications are currently pending for the September meeting and discussed the status of pending board appointments from the Mayor's office.
